8. The Surveyor of the Upazilla Land Office, Ramgati, Lakshmipur, submitted a report dated 25.04.2013 regarding the land where the land is found as Khas land. In the report it has been stated that the gifted land of the petitioner's grand father was never a private property according to the record. 

 10. The Headmaster of the Alexander Model Government Primary School issued a letter dated 29.04.2013 where it requested guideline from the Upazilla Sikha Officer regarding the Donor Member as the land is khas land. 

 12. Suddenly, the respondent No.3 on behalf of the respondent No.2 issued a letter vide Memo No. Prasia/5P/16Bidda-Chotto/2009/913 dated 15.7.2013 and stated that there is no scope to include any member of land-giver in the Managing Committee of Alexander Model Government Primary School as the land is khas land and therefore the gift by the petitioner's grand father was not a valid one. 

 17. Mr. Amit Talukder, learned Deputy Attorney General along with Mr. Md. Jahangir Alam, Assistant Attorney General appearing on behalf of the respondents submits that .24 decimals of land in plot No.7619/8297 in JL No.18 of Char Alexander Mouza Ramgai Upazilla under District Lakshmipur has been recorded in khas khatian No.1 of the Government and it was finally published in P.S. record of 1935 and in remarks column of the khatian it was written as school. In S.A survey of 1960 also the said .24 decimals of land of plot No.7619/8297 was also recorded in khas khatian No.1 of the Government. They have further submitted that in this regard the grand father of the petitioner was not the owner of the said land. As per land record the school is situated as khas land and Government is the owner of the land. They have also submitted that the respondent No.3 legally and lawfully issued the impugned letter as per Nitimala dated 15.11.2012 and, as such the Rule is liable to be discharged. 

 19. It also appears that the Surveyor of the Upazilla Land Officer, Ramgati, Lakshmipur in pursuance of Memo No.10 dated 18.04.2013 submitted a report dated 25.04.2013 to the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Ramgati, Laxmipur, wherein it is clearly stated that one Abdur Rahman Munsi son of late Rahim Uddin Patwary, Village-Char-Alexander, Mouza No.1 of Char-Alexander, in Khatian No.1 and dag No.8297 by a registered deed No.1459 dated 12.08.1935 gifted 0.24 acres of land in favour of the President of District School Board, Noakhali which was recorded as Char Alexander High School on 21.07.1996. It also appears that the gifted land was wrongly recorded in the Government khas Khatian and the petitioner's grand father Abdur Rahman Munsi filed N.H. Misc Case No.01/1933-34 and on the basis of N.H. Misc. Case No.01/1933-34 the said .24 acres of land was recorded in his name and gifted said .24 decimals of land to Char Alexander Primary School.
